Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. Afghanistan have scripted a famous victory against West Indies and they have taken the initial lead in the 3-match ODI series. The hosts will look to bounce back as they take them on again in the second game at the same venue on 11th June at 1430 local (1830 GMT). Join us for it. Until then, cheers and goodbye!

Man of the Match, Rashid Khan thanks the Almighty for his performance. Adds that after losing three T20I games, it was great to come back in such a manner. Feels that the wicket was not that good for the batsmen for scoring quick runs. Adds that their bowlers bowled good lines and lengths which made it difficult for the batsmen. Mentions that he practices well in the nets with the coaching staff and thankfully the results are showing on the field. Ends by dedicating this victory to the victims of the Kabul attack. Wishes that this win will bring happiness to his nation.

Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Stanikzai thanks the Almighty for the victory. Reckons that it is a really good day for them as they won their first game of the tour. Mentions that the target was good enough as he trusted his bowlers to defend it. Adds that they are looking forward to playing positive cricket in the upcoming games. Acknowledges the performances of Javed Ahmadi who took responsibility in the middle. Credits Rashid Khan for his brilliant spell and proving what a brilliant talent he is.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder says that they were not good enough. Feels that they lacked energy and were lethargic. Mentions that the intent was missing when they came out to bat. Further adds that they were 20 odd after first 10 overs and didn't get any sort of momentum and opines that it is not acceptable at all. Reckons that it is a wake-up call for them and they need to work harder. States that they need to be professional in the coming games. Ends by saying that they were not good enough today.

Earlier in the day, Afghanistan opted to bat first and some heroics from Gulbadin Naib and Javed Ahmadi helped them cross the 200-run mark after a really shabby start to the game. The decision to bat first worked well for them as the outfield got slower in the latter part of the game. Stay tuned for the presentation.

The young leggie picked a couple of wickets in each of his first two overs to shatter the hosts. No one could really read the ball as Rashid Khan kept spitting venom throughout his spell. He ended with his best ODI figures of 8.4-1-18-7. Alzarri Joseph and Jonathan Carter showed some resistance but the game was long lost by then.

A fantastic performance by Afghanistan with the ball has handed them a 1-0 lead in the 3-match ODI series against West Indies. After posting a decent total on the board, they needed to start really well with the ball. Dawlat Zadran and Mohammad Nabi did not disappoint as they kept the pressure on the batsmen who could hardly score any runs. None of the West Indian batsman except Shai Hope looked comfortable in the middle and once Rashid Khan arrived, the misery got even worse.

OUT! Rashid finishes with a 7-wicket haul! He has been sensational tonight and kudos to him for putting up such an entertaining display. Slips in the googly on middle, spins away slightly. Cummins fails to read it, gets beaten on the defense and the furniture behind him gets shattered. A dismal performance from the Windies. AFGHANISTAN WIN BY 63 RUNS!
The change of angle almost does the trick! Tosses it around off, spins away sharply. Cummins prods forward to counter it but is beaten all ends up. That wasn't far from the off stump.
Floated in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Bowls this one around leg stump, Cummins looks to play it across but misses to get hit on the pads. A confident appeal for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head. Replays show it pitched outside leg.
Another slower one and on  middle, Shannon defends it to the left side of the bowler.
Slower delivery outside off, Gabriel fails to read it and is late in bringing his bat down.
Fullish in line of the stumps, Miguel jams it to mid on for a run.
Slower delivery on middle and leg, Cummins looks to nudge it but misses to get hit on the pads. That was surely going down leg.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. The umpire has signalled a wide. Two in a row.
Wide! Bowls this one way outside off, Miguel is not bothered by it.
Fullish delivery on middle and off, Cummins strides forward to defend it.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Gabriel steers it down to third man for a single.
Fullish outside off, Gabriel drags his heave through mid on. A run taken.
Googly around off, spins in. Gabriel prods forward to defend but is struck on the pads. A loud appeal for an LBW is turned down. May be the impact was outside off.
Shannon Gabriel is the last man in.

OUT! The googly again does the trick for the spin wizard! Gets his sixth wicket and he is running away with the show. Bowls the wrong one around off, spins in sharply. Joseph hangs back deep to block it but misses to get hit flush on the back pad. Khan appeals immediately and the umpire has no hesitation in ruling it out. Afghanistan are now just a wicket away from an emphatic victory.
Quicker one outside off, extra  bounce on that. Joseph looks to counter it but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Loopy delivery, defended towards cover-point.
Floated outside off, Joseph goes for a wild slog across the line but is beaten all ends up.

On a length outside off, Cummins dabs it towards backward point who dives to his right to make a good stop. Cummins was looking for a run but has to turn back quickly as the throw comes to the keeper.
Fullish and angling in, Cummins looks to flick it but is hit on the pads.
Length ball outside off, Cummins pushes at it but gets an outside edge to third man for a couple.
Naib comes around the wicket and bowls it on a length outside off, Cummins pokes at it but gets beaten.
Back of a length delivery around off, Joseph rises on his toes and dabs it towards short third man. A run taken.
Dug in short, Joseph sits under it.
Gulbadin Naib is back into the attack.
Joseph goes back and works it through mid-wicket. A run taken.
Slips in a googly outside off, Alzarri goes back and defends it to covers.
Floated on off, Cummins jams it past the bowler. However, Rashid appeals but it falls on deaf ears. Single taken.
The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Wide! Down the leg side, Cummins looks to play it across but misses.
Googly outside leg, spinning in. Cummins looks to defend but is hit on the pads. There is an appeal for an LBW but turned down.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, Miguel defends it off his front foot.
Tossed up around off, pushed to covers.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now a maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle. Meanwhile, Rashid Khan returns for a bowl.
That almost sneaked through! Low full toss on off, perhaps slower. Cummins is foxed by it but manages to keep it out towards backward point. A run taken.
This is testing stuff from Zadran. Bangs it short on off, Cummins has to drop his wrists as he sees it going past him in a jiffy.
Dug in short, Cummins ducks under it.
Fullish delivery, Alzarri drives it through wide mid off for a single.
Miguel Cummins strides out to bat.

OUT! Carter's painful innings comes to an end! The tourists have broken an important partnership which had started to threaten. Shortish delivery in line of the stumps, Carter is cramped up for room a bit but still goes through with his heave. Gets it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket. The substitute, Shafiq stays composed to take it easily. 78 runs needed of 64 balls.

This is good fielding from Afghanistan. This can boost the morale of the entire side. Fullish delivery outside off, Carter drives it uppishly towards covers. Hamza dives to full length to his left to stop certain runs for his side.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Full toss on the pads, asking to be hit and Joseph obliges. Clips it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Fullish on length on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket.

Good effort, Khan! Fuller length ball on off, Joseph lifts it over the bowler's head. Rashid Khan hares to his left, puts in a slide near the fence to keep the ball in play. Saves two runs for his side.
Mid off has been sent back to the boundary.
Slower in pace again outside off, Joseph can only hit it down to mid off.
Fullish delivery outside off, Joseph comes forward and defends it to covers.
Slower delivery outside off, Joseph throws his bat at it but gets beaten.
Gulbadin Naib is called back.

Fullish delivery on middle, Joseph clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single. West Indies are taking this game deep now. Good sensible batting this. The hosts need 84 to win from 72 balls with three wickets in hand.
Length delivery in line of the stump, Carter looks to defend it tentatively but gets it off the inner half towards backward square leg. The batsmen take Rashid Khan on this time and cross safely.
Slower delivery down the leg side, Carter works it towards square leg. Rashid is quick to run in from backward square leg to deny the single.
On a length and angling into the hips, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Well bowled! Short of a delivery on off, zips through the surface. Joseph drops his wrists and just about evades it. Wanted the wide but it was at shoulder height.
Wide! Another bouncer and this time its on off, Joseph sits under it. This one was too short and it has been rightly called a wide.
Dug in short on middle and leg, Alzarri ducks under it to evade it.
Dawlat Zadran is back for a bowl.

Poor running! Darted in towards the pads, Joseph tucks it fine past the keeper and manages to get it past Nabi at short fine leg. He hares after it and keeps it down to a single. The batsmen should have run harder, there was an easy two on offer. Lack of match awareness.
A bit short around off, spinning away. Pushed off the back foot to covers.
Stays back to the length delivery on middle and defends it solidly.
Wide! Down the leg side, Alzarri misses his flick.
SIX! Bang! Tossed up in line of the stumps, Joseph lines it up and whips it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Hit that with a lot of authority. That will give him confidence.
Goes back to the flatter delivery and  turns it through square leg for a couple.
Fullish delivery in line of the stumps, Carter drags his heave to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A solid front foot defense by Joseph to end the over.
Straighter one outside off, Alzarri plays for the turn but gets beaten.
Fullish delivery, eased to long on for a single.
Joseph heaves this flighted delivery over mid on for a run. That was miscued actually.
Three Wides! Slips this one down the leg side, the keeper fails to collect it. The ball rolls towards fine leg and Hamza tracks it down. Two extra runs taken along with the wide.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Carter turns it to mid-wicket for a run. The batsmen think about the second but decide against it.
A bit short around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Slider on middle and leg, clipped to the leg side. If he missed that he would have been a candidate for an LBW.
Fullish delivery, swept to deep square leg for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Stays back to this one and defends it.
Carter defends it with the spin to point this time.
Leans forward to the tossed up delivery and defends it.
Amir Hamza will replace Rashid Khan in the attack!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Not out! Tossed up outside off, Joseph pushes hard at it but gets a thick outside edge. The ball spoons towards short third man and falls down. Joseph wants the run but is rightly sent back. The fielder goes across and throws it to the keeper who dislodges the bails. It is referred upstairs but Alzarri got back home safely.
Tossed up delivery, Carter comes down the track and lifts it to long on for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Carter looks to slog sweep it but misses. That missed the off stump by a whisker.
Wide outside off this time, left alone.
Wide! Going down the leg side, Carter misses his whip. Zazai takes the bails off but the southpaw has his bat grounded.
Quicker one on off, punched to covers.
Mohammad Nabi is called back into the attack.
Fullish on middle and leg, eased through mid on for a single.
Floated delivery, defended off the front foot.
Googly around off, sharp away turn. Carter is beaten on the push.
Short on leg stump, Carter goes for the pull but misses. The ball hits the pads, goes onto hit his bat and goes towards the keeper. He bends low to his right but fails to reach it in time.

Tossed up around leg stump, Carter looks to nudge it away but seems to have been struck on the thigh pad. Zazai collects it well and goes up in an appeal. However, no response from the umpire. The replays confirm that the sound was due to the thigh pad.

Not out! Slips in a googly around off, turning away. Carter goes for the drive but misses. Zazai is really quick to take the bails off. Time for the replays. They show that Jonathan had his back foot momentarily forward but he got it back inside the crease in time.
There is a stumping appeal against Carter. Afghanistan look confident.

Drinks break. West Indies have been blown away by Rashid Khan and he still has five overs up his sleeve. They need 110 runs from 108 balls with three wickets in hand. It will need something heroic from the Windies' lower order to bounce back.

FOUR! Streaky runs! Full length delivery well outside off, Joseph throws his bat at it but gets a thick outside edge that flies past the slip fielder for a boundary. Stanikzai can perhaps be more attacking with his captaincy. Can't let the game slip from such a commanding position.
Angling away from the southpaw this time. Dabbed with ease to third man for a single.
Similar length ball on middle, Carter answers it with a solid straight bat.
Length delivery outside off, Joseph hangs back and punches it to the fielder at backward point. He fumbles to concede the single.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side this time, Joseph misses his flick again.

Wide! On a length and angling down leg, Joseph moves inside the line and looks it clip it. That was not far from the leg stump but unfortunately it has been called a wide. Zadran has his hands on his head.
Good length ball angling across Jonathan. He steers it past the right side of the point fielder for a single.
Slower delivery outside off, Carter lines it up and looks to hoick it across the line but misses it completely.
Carter drives it towards long off for a single to keep strike.
Carter prods forward in defence. Gets an inside edge towards the fielder at square leg.

Fuller into the pads, Carter tries to clip it but gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Replays show that it was pitched outside leg. How long can he survive Rashid's brilliant bowling?
Joseph punches it through covers for a single. Well played Joseph.
Tosses this one around off, Joseph tries to defend it but gets beaten by the away spin. He has survived two balls.
Googly around off, Joseph fails to clip it. Gets rapped on the pads. A stifled appeal by the players as it was going down leg.
Short delivery outside off, Carter tries to play the ramp shot but he fails to make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Carter defends it back to the bowler.
Length delivery outside off again, Carter pushes it towards the fielder at point but he cannot get it past the fielder.
Length delivery around off, Carter dabs it towards the fielder at backward point.
Length delivery outside off, Carter swings his bat but fails to make contact.
Good length delivery outside off, Carter guides it towards third man for a couple.
Dawlat Zadran comes back for a bowl.
Alzarri Joseph is the new man in.

OUT! Second ODI fifer for Rashid Khan! This man has not just turned tables but he has also created havoc in the West Indian dressing room. Bowls a wrong 'un outside off, stays a bit low. Nurse camps back and tries to clip it on the leg side. Fails to make contact and gets hit flush on the pads. Rashid Khan starts celebrating before the umpire raises the finger as he knows that it can't get any more plumb than this.
Wrong 'un outside off, Nurse goes for the slog sweep but he fails to make contact.

Around middle and leg, Carter defends it back to the bowler. Rashid Khan and co appeal for LBW as they think it was the pad first and in the process the bowler lets the ball through. The batsmen run a single.

Quicker into the pads, Nurse goes for the sweep at first but later thinks of leaving it. Ends up gloving it fine past the leg slip region. Stanikzai at short fine leg goes to his right but makes a mess of it. Sloppy work from him. The batsmen run three.
Full toss in the line of the stumps, Carter drives it towards long on for a single.
Another wrong 'un from a fuller length around off, Carter prods forward to defend it but gets beaten by the away turn. He is somehow surviving.
Fuller in the line of the stumps, Nurse defends it on the leg side.
Shorter around off, punched towards the fielder at covers.
Nurse pushes it back to the bowler. Hamza dives to his right and makes a good half-stop to save a single for his team.
Around off, Nurse prods forward and defends it towards the fielder at point.
Floated outside off, Carter clips it through square leg for a single.
Angling into the pads, Nurse clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Amir Hamza is called back for a bowl.
Another googly around off, Carter somehow manages to defend it. Finally an over from Rashid which does not land him a wicket.
Short delivery and Carter gets enough time in the world to pull it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Fuller in the line of the stumps, Carter defends it back to the bowler.
Another one down the leg side, Carter fails to flick it through. Gets rapped on the pads.
Googly around leg, Carter goes for the paddle sweep. Gets it fine off the inner half for a couple towards fine leg.
Short and wide from Rashid this time, Carter cuts it hard. The fielder at backward point dives to his right and makes a fine stop.
Again fuller around off, Nurse sweeps again. This one through the square leg region for a couple again.
Short and wide outside off, Nurse punches it through covers for a couple.
FOUR! Good shot! Floated outside off, Nurse kneels down and sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Nurse stays deep and defends it well.
Nurse defends it on the leg side.
Quicker outside off, Nurse tries to go downtown but he fails to make contact. Luckily for the batsman the ball whizzes past the off pole.

It is all happening out there. Almost another wicket. Another googly in line of the stumps, turning away from Carter who looks to defend but is struck on the pads. A confident shout for an LBW but the umpire is unmoved. The replays show that it would have probably missed the off stump. End of another game defining over from Rashid Khan. Two wickets from it. He has four wickets in total from his two overs.

Misses his hat-trick by a slight margin. A loud shout for an LBW is turned down. Tossed up outside off, spinning in. Nurse looks to sweep it hard but misses to get pinged on the back pad. A huge appeal for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that the impact was outside off. A leg bye taken.
Ashley Nurse makes his way out to the middle. He will be facing the hat-trick ball. Can he defend it?

OUT! Bowled 'em! What a magician this young man from Afghanistan is! He has pushed the hosts in dire straits now. Slips in a googly outside off, spins in sharply. Holder prods forward to defend but misses the line of the ball completely. The ball sneaks in through the gap between bat and pad to rattle the stumps. He is up and running. Rashid is once again on a hat-trick. Take a bow, champion!
The skipper, Jason Holder comes out to bat.

OUT! Rashid Khan is turning the game on its head! Bowls a loopy leg spinner outside off, spins away a touch. Hope shuffles across and commits to it. Ends up getting a thick outside edge that flies low towards Mohammad Nabi at first slip. He is as sharp as a hawk and dives to his left to take a stunning catch. The Windies have lost half of their side now and are in deep trouble.
Full on off, Shai jams it back to Khan who leaps to stop it in his followthrough.

Close shave! Googly outside off, spins in sharply. Hope shuffles across and looks to defend it. However, he gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball just falls in front of the diving silly point fielder.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Again a guide towards third man but no runs there. He needs to rotate the strike.
Carter gets an intentional outside edge on it but cannot land a run for his team.
In the line of the stumps, Carter gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it away.
Short and wide outside off, Carter shoulders his arms to it.
Driven through the wide mid off region for a single.
Double-wicket maiden for Rashid Khan! Carter gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Googly again from Rashid Khan. Carter is surely not reading him well as he gets an outside edge to that one. Luckily he survives.

WIDE! Fuller into the pads, Carter goes for the sweep but fails to make contact. The ball goes through and just whizzes past the leg pole. Rashid Khan thought that he had his man but the umpire was quick to signal it as a wide.
Wrong 'un around off, Carter tries to defend it but he gets beaten by the away spin.
Floater around off, Carter defends it well. Negotiates the hat-trick ball well.
Jonathan Carter is the next man in. He will be facing the hat-trick ball. Can he survive it?

OUT! Rashid Khan, you beauty! First the leg spinner, now the googly. This youngster is the master of leg spin. Floats a googly around off. Chase tries to clip it on the leg side, gets beaten and is hit flush on the back pad. The players appeal loudly and the umpire is quick to raise his finger up. Roston Chase has surely a debut to forget as he walks back to the hut bagging a golden duck.
Debutant Roston Chase makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Rashid Khan strikes gold first ball! Floats this one outside off, Mohammed shuffles across and tries to defend it. Gets beaten by the spin as he manages to outside edge it. The ball flies straight to the fielder at slip. Nabi makes no mistake and takes a simple catch. Such a brilliant bowler and he takes no time to make a difference in the game. Jason has to walk back as no one makes a mistake this time.
Rashid Khan is finally given the ball.
Shortish around off, Hope punches it towards the fielder at covers. No runs taken.
Clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, Mohammed slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Spinning in from outside off, Hope shuffles across and works it towards long on for a single.
Floats this one outside off, Hope tries to defend it. Gets an outside edge past the keeper for a couple.
Low full toss on the pads, Mohammed drives it towards long on for a single.
The big hit meant that the ball got lost. The replacement has been brought in.
SIX! Enough says Hope! Fuller outside off, Hope kneels down and slog sweeps powerfully over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen.
Full toss outside off, Hope drives it through the cover region. The fielder from sweeper cover cuts it off and the batsmen run a couple.
Hope stays deep in his crease and punches it on the off side.
Fuller around off, Hope drives it back to the bowler.
Wide! The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact. Wide signaled by the umpire.
Eased towards long on for a single.
The batsman plays the square cut. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Samiullah Shenwari comes into the attack.

Not Out! Luck favours Mohammed this time. Short delivery around off, spinning in. Jason stays leg side of the ball and tries to cut it hard. Gets a top edge on it and the ball goes straight to the keeper who collects it somehow on the second attempt. The players appeal and the umpire rules it out. The umpire later goes upstairs to check for the no ball and replays show that he is clear there. But they also check if the ball hit the keeper's helmet and fortunately for the batsman it did hit Zazai's grill and so, he survives. A lucky reprieve for him.

Jason Mohammed has been caught behind but the umpires check for the no ball. The front foot is fine but they are also checking whether the ball deflected on to the grill of Zazai while he collected that ball.
Fuller around middle, Jason pushes it back to the bowler.
Mohammed stands tall and defends it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller into the pads, Jason clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket. The fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end but he ends up hitting Hope. He slips there but he was well in the crease.
Short around off, punched towards long on for a single.
Quicker around off, Hope guides it towards the fielder at backward point.
Mohammad Nabi is brought back in for a bowl.
Short delivery outside off, Mohammed defends it back to the bowler.
Hope clips towards mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single.
Jason turns this one towards square leg for a single.
Fuller around off, Mohammed defends it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller into the pads, clipped through wide mid on for a single.
Drifting in from outside off, Hope defends it neatly.
Another good length delivery around off. This one was probing for the batsman who first thought of going for it but later decided to leave it.
Good length delivery, nipping away from the batsman. Jason shoulders his arms to it.
Short and wide outside off, Mohammed cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Short and wide outside off, miscues his punch through covers for a single.
Length delivery around off, pushed towards wide mid on. No runs taken.

Fullish delivery around off, Hope punches it to covers. Rashid Khan gets across to it and has a shy at the bowler's end as Mohammed got out of his crease for a moment. However, the shy misses and so no harm done.

Time for drinks. The bowling has been good so far from Afghanistan and they haven't let West Indies dictate terms. In fact, the home side look a bit tentative. With Rashid Khan to come, it holds the visitors in good stead. They need to keep on chipping away at the wickets while the hosts need to keep the scoreboard ticking. The equation reads 166 runs to get from 198 balls.
Floated outside off, Hope strokes it to sweeper cover for a run.
A bit short outside off, cut towards point for a single.

Another confident shout for an LBW falls on deaf ears. Hamza keeps it full this time, coming in with the arm. Jason Mohammed looks to nudge it but is hit on the pads again. No interest from the umpire once again. The replays again show it was heading down leg.

Flatter delivery coming in with the angle, Mohammed looks to flick it but is late on the shot. Misses to get rapped on the pads. A loud shout for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. Replays show it would have gone down leg.
Fullish delivery on middle, eased through mid on for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Back of a length outside off, Mohammed cuts it uppishly to third man for a couple. Gets off the mark. End of a successful over for the visitors.
Shortish outside off, Hope punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
On a length around off, Hope stays back and defends it to covers.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Jason Mohammed is the new man in.

OUT! Brilliant take, Amir Hamza! Fuller length delivery angling away from Lewis. He goes at it with hard hands but ends up slicing it over covers. Hamza comes in a bit, as the ball swirls in the wind. He judges it well and dives to his right to take a gem of a catch. He is ecstatic and so are his teammates. West Indies need 172 runs from 209 balls. Good tight bowling from the visitors has brought about the wicket.
Straying on the hips, Lewis tucks it to short mid-wicket.
Floated on middle, Hope defends it back to Hamza. Another tidy over for Afghanistan.
Full delivery outside off, Hope lunges forward in defense.
Flatter delivery on off, Hope pushes it to covers.
Tossed up around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Quicker delivery in line of the stumps, Lewis punches it to mid on for a run.
Fuller length ball outside off, Hope pushes at it with hard hands but gets an outside edge past the vacant slip region. A couple taken.
Wide! Bouncer outside off and it's too high. Hope lets it go.
Length delivery and straight on this occasion, Hope stays back and blocks it. Good channel from Naib.
Shortish delivery around off, Evin cuts it to deep point for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Hope guides it to third man for a single.
Good length delivery angling away. Lewis punches it through point for a single.
Full delivery outside off, Hope drives it crisply to sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker one around the pads, Lewis looks to help it to short fine leg but is hit on the pad. A slight appeal for an LBW but turned down.
Shuffles across this time and defends it off his back foot.
Floated in line of the stumps, nudged to mid-wicket again with the spin.
Tossed up on middle and leg, defended to mid-wicket.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Straying on the pads, Lewis nudges it towards backward square leg and sets off. Calls for two straightaway and gets it.
Amir Hamza is back for a bowl.
This one comes in with the arm. Lewis sweeps it to the leg side for a single. A stifled appeal is denied by the umpire.
Loopy delivery, turning away. Lewis comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to mid off.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flatter delivery on middle, Evin punches it towards Nabi who dives to his right but fails to stop it. A run taken.
A bit short around off, spinning away. Lewis cuts it hard past the diving fielder at covers. Picks up two runs for doing so.
Length delivery angling in from outside off, Hope hangs back and places it to point.
Full and outside off, Hope resists the temptation to drive and lets it be.

Loud shout for an LBW turned down! Fuller in length around leg stump, Lewis shuffles across and looks to clip it across but misses to get rapped on the pad. An appeal follows but the umpire is not interested. The batsmen sneak in a leg bye. The replays show that it probably pitched outside leg.
Fuller length ball on off, Lewis drives it crisply to mid off.
Wide! Sprays it down the leg side, Lewis looks to tuck it but misses. The keeper collects the ball and up goes in appeal along with Naib. However, the umpire is quick to outstretch his arms.
Length delivery on off, Lewis waits on the back foot and punches it to mid off.
Full length delivery outside off, Hope drives it through square of the wicket on the off side. A run taken.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled by the umpire. Maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
Tossed up on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
The bails are back on as the wind is not blowing that hard now.
Floated outside off, turning away. Lewis leaves it alone.
Fullish on middle and leg, Hope works it towards short mid-wicket. The fielder moves to his left, dives but fails to stop it. Concedes a single.
Flatter delivery in line of the stumps, Evin punches it down to long on for a single.
Quicker delivery outside off, Evin punches it to covers.
On a length on off, defended off the back foot.
Mohammad Nabi is back for a bowl.
Shortish in length and wide outside off, Hope brings his bat towards it but leaves it alone.
Length delivery on off, Shai plays it with an angled bat to point.
FOUR! Hit with disdain! Short and width on offer, Hope flashes it through covers and the ball rockets to the fence. That must boost his morale to a good extent.
Length delivery on off, Hope is assured on his back foot as he strokes it to covers.
Dug in short and tries to strangle Lewis. He gets into an awkward position to pull it unconvincingly to fine leg. A run taken.
Good length delivery on off, Evin camps back and punches it to mid off.
Gulbadin Naib is introduced into the attack.
Shortish in length and width on offer, Hope is not bothered by that one. Zadran once again lets out a grunt. Hundred percent effort from the quick bowler. 4 runs from the over.
Uppish but safe! Fuller length ball angling away from Lewis. Inviting him for the drive and he obliges. However, he mistimes it aerially over covers. Three runs taken.
Full delivery outside off, Evin plants his front foot across and lets it go.
Good length ball on middle, punched off the inner half back to the bowler.
The ground staff are looking concerned about the rain. Hopefully, it stays low.
Straying on the hips, Hope tucks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Short delivery outside off, Hope swivels across and goes for the big pull but misses it completely. That was a loose shot.
Tossed up outside off, Lewis creams it through cover-point. Rashid Khan hares after it and slides near the fence to keep the ball in play. Two runs taken.
Quicker one around leg stump, Lewis looks to hit it over the short fine leg fielder but is hit on the pads. Missed out on that.
Flat on leg stump, tucked to short fine leg.
Tossed up delivery, Lewis sweeps it past the right side of the short fine leg fielder. Nabi comes across from deep square leg and keeps it down to two.
Flatter delivery on off, Lewis stays back and defends it.
Shuffles across to the length delivery and works it to short mid-wicket.
Fullish in length and around off, straigthens a touch after hitting the deck. Lewis comes forward to defend but gets it from the outer half to third man. A run taken.
On a length and angling away from Lewis. He lets it go.
Fuller length ball outside off, moving away. Hope strides forward and guides it nicely past point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, shoots off the pitch. Hope hops back and adjusts well to tap it to point.
On a length on middle and off, Hope covers the line and defends it nicely.
Good length delivery outside off, shaping away a touch. Hope punches it off the back foot to point.
Change of ends for Dawlat Zadran.
Fullish ball around off, Lewis defends it solidly.
Shorter in length on off, Hope hangs back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up delivery, Hope makes room and eases it to cover-point.
Floated on off, Hope strides forward to defend it to covers.
Flatter delivery around off, defended solidly off the back foot down the track.
Amir Hamza comes into the attack.
Fullish outside off, Lewis drives it to deepish mid off. Another tidy over from the visitors.
Tossed up around off, Lewis lunges forward and defends it towards Nabi.
This one is a bit wider outside off. An easy leave for Evin.
Quicker delivery outside off, drifting in. Evin covers his stumps and lets it go.

Tossed up outside off, Hope drives it towards wide mid off and takes on the fielder who comes across to his left. Good early call and the batsmen cross safely. There was a direct hit at the striker's end but no harm done.
Coming in with the arm towards the pads, Lewis flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Fuller length ball around off, nipping in this time. Hope lunges forward confidently to keep it out. A wicket-maiden for Zadran. Just what Afghanistan needed from him at the start.
On a length outside off, nips away sharply after pitching. Shai plants his front foot across and lets it go.
In the channel outside off, some away movement on that. Hope stays back and places it to point.
Short of a length on off, Shai stays back and blocks it towards the bowler.
Length delivery on middle, Hope hangs back and defends it.
Shai Hope strides out to bat.

OUT! Zadran strikes!  Bowls a nice inswinging delivery on middle, Powell prods forward to counter it but misses to get pinged on the front pad. A confident shout for an LBW and up goes the umpire's finger. Good bowling and he gets rewarded for it. Afghanistan need to keep on chipping away at the wickets to mount the pressure on the hosts.
Darted into Powell again. He flicks it past the diving mid-wicket fielder to his right. A run taken.
Flatter one on a length on off, pushed back to Nabi.
Quicker one again, Powell lunges forward in defense.
Flatter delivery on off, Kieran stays back and defends it solidly.
Similar delivery, tucked to wide mid on this time.
Quicker delivery, coming in with the arm. Powell misses his nudge to get rapped on the pads.
Mohammad Nabi to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Fuller length but wide outside off this time, Lewis is not bothered by that one.
Good length delivery on off, seaming away after hitting the deck. Powell steers it after hopping back to third man. A run taken.
Length delivery slanting across Powell. He strides forward and places it with an open face to point.
West Indies are away! Back of a length on middle and leg, Lewis tucks it around the corner for a run.
Another one on a length but a bit wider outside off stump this time, Lewis points his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
Good length delivery on off, Lewis covers his stumps and sees it go through safely.
We are back for the chase. Evin Lewis and Kieran Powell to open the batting for West Indies. Dawlat Zadran to start the proceedings with the ball for Afghanistan. Two slips in place. Here we go...
